name: testdino-e2e-check
description: QA project for TDV2-1087: e2e (TesterArmy) runs and Playwright runs reported to TestDino staging.

scripts.e2e:filtered: npm run reset && e2e run --grep "home page shows the header"
scripts.e2e:long: npm run reset && E2E_LONG_TEST=1 e2e run e2e/long-running.e2e.ts
scripts.e2e:mobile: npm run reset && e2e run --config e2e.mobile.config.ts
scripts.install:browsers: node node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install chromium firefox webkit && playwright install chromium firefox webkit
